case_021: angular_precise + limited_two_tone + subtle_contact_shadow: straight-edged faceted planes with measured lapel corners and clean joins, whole figure built from taupe-grey plus cream in value steps, and only small soft contact shadows at the neck hollow and under the lapel with midtones left open.
case_051: bold_outer_sparse_inner + cool_nocturne + broad_blended_plane: heavy dark silhouette contour on hair/shoulder with only two hairline collarbone marks inside, indigo shadow skin over blue-green garment with restrained warm lip note, neck and chest modeled as broad blended planes with the silhouette edge still crisp.
case_081: broken_dry + airy_pastel + fine_tonal_hatching: dry graphite contour visibly breaking along the sleeve and skirt edges, low-contrast lavender/pink/blue pastels with protected whites and hair as the only grounding dark, fine diagonal hatch concentrated in the skirt and sleeve folds and kept off the skin.
case_111: broken_dry + muted_split_complement + transparent_glaze: palette (teal garment vs warm skin vs olive skirt) and glazed shadows showing local blue through them are fine, but the contour is an unbroken continuous dark line with no dry texture or gaps in all three seeds — a real linework defect, not a legibility limit, since case_081 on this same sheet shows broken_dry surviving this density.
case_141: crisp_uniform + skin_centered_neutral + crisp_shape_shadow: even-weight crisp contours with exact joins at neckline/jaw and open facial features, warm skin carrying the palette against quiet taupe-grey clothing, and hard-edged shape shadows across the clavicle and under the jaw that clarify planes without fragmenting the face.
case_171: elastic_pressure + cool_nocturne + subtle_contact_shadow: lapel and hair-edge strokes visibly swell where forms overlap and taper to hairlines at the lit collarbone, indigo/violet skin shadow with blue-green garment midtones and restrained warm jaw note, soft contact shadow under the chin and hair with reflected violet kept in the neck shadow.
case_201: fine_tapered + limited_two_tone + soft_two_band: hairline tapered contours that fade out along the arms with very restrained interior fold marks, grey-brown plus cream two-tone in value steps, and clean light/shadow banding on the sleeves and torso with lightly feathered transitions.
case_231: rounded_soft + cool_nocturne + soft_two_band: smoothly rounded shoulder, sleeve and hem contours with no corners and gently reinforced features, indigo top over blue-green skirt with cool desaturated skin and only warm hands, and two clean value bands per sleeve with softly feathered edges.
case_261: rounded_soft + warm_earth + subtle_contact_shadow: soft rounded sleeve and hem turns with gentle reinforcement at cuffs and hands, olive/clay/brown/cream earth palette throughout, and small contact shadows where the sweater hem meets the skirt and under the cuffs with open warm midtones.
case_291: selective_edge + skin_centered_neutral + subtle_contact_shadow: the cream top's outline is a near-invisible hairline that drops out against the grey ground, form completed by the cream/dark-skirt colour boundary plus a few dark accents at waistband and hair, warm skin-centred neutrals, and a soft contact shadow under the hem and hands.
